question: If each vowel in the word HISTORY is changed to the letter preceding it in the English alphabetical order and each consonant is changed to the letter following it in the English alphabetical order, then how many vowels will be there in the group of letters thus formed?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Each vowel in the word HISTORY is changed to the letter preceding it in the English alphabetical order and each consonant is changed to the letter following it in the English alphabetical order,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d66171ed232f49f6a7f0983f593366e4f78b4e7c92442e29df33613fa79d83e.png] 

Thus, **2 **vowels will be there in the group of letters thus formed.

Hence, "2" is the correct answer.
